answer: Make each epoch's stamp memory-hard and seeded by a value unknowable until the epoch opens, so no farmer can precompute a pearl-string of stamps ahead of time. One honest agent grinds a single marble of work per round; a thousand clones must each grind their own against the fresh seed in parallel, with no juniper-shortcut to share the cost. Precomputation dies, reuse dies, and the power bill scales linearly with the farm's size.
